phase0.notes: get-instructions is empty (no read-only phrases). Safety: environment local, dry_run_default false, snapshots_retention 10, crash_flag not tripped, domain lock trusted to http://task-11.local. Preflight: all 3 product URLs and 3 replicas return HTTP 200, no auth wall. No maint-runner baseline directory existed, so DevConnect's own pre-write scoped backups plus snapshot 10 served as the baseline.

notes: Capture engine substituted: node Playwright (plugin scripts/node_modules) read getComputedStyle/getBoundingClientRect of .pd-ctas, .tq-ctas and each child <a> on the WP page and on the HTML replica. The values were written in the canonical flat {source_id:{property:value}} shape and fed to compare_rendered_measurements.py -> measured_assert.py at each width (78 captures: 3 products x 2 sides x 13 widths).

Widths: qa_breakpoints.core 1440,768,430 (project-config) + 390 (CLAUDE.md) + boundaries discovered from the page's own CSSOM: 1200,1025,1024,1023,992,767,600,599,479. resolve_qa_widths.py could not discover them because python playwright is missing, so the same design_probe.js COLLECT_BOUNDARIES payload was run through node Playwright instead.

Result at every width: each page has 1 .pd-ctas and 1 .tq-ctas, 2 links in each, with the same text/href/class as the replica (pbtn pbtn--solid / pbtn pbtn--line). Width, height, dx and dy are identical, as are flex-direction, wrap, gap, colours, background, border, radius and links per row. No overflow and no horizontal page scroll.
All 234 raw measured_assert findings were line_height (replica 'normal' vs site 16-24px). Under the typography-authority rule they move to inherited_from_site: reported, not counted.

inherited_from_site.detail: The replica computes line-height:normal on .pd-ctas/.tq-ctas and their <a>. The WP page computes 24px (17.07px/17.08px/20px on the buttons at 1024/1025/1200) from the site cascade (Hello Elementor/Kit body line-height). Box heights match on both sides, so no geometry moves.

notes: audit.json was built from dev/get-audit-log rows 2380-2390 (http_method MCP-TOOL, post_id 230/231/232). The server log recorded every dispatch, so attribution rests on evidence, not on a reconstruction.

Observed changes come from DevConnect's pre-write scoped DB backups (230: 1790608595-HVE8Q8Bx, 231: 1790608514-AFf4ksTZ, 232: 1790608600-jvLoE9ix) diffed against DB snapshot backups/10-before-portal-chrome.sql (taken 15:23:31 GMT, after the writes). The only rows that changed on the 3 posts are buttons, _buttons_0_cta, _buttons_1_cta, buttons_0_cta, buttons_1_cta. wp_posts rows are unchanged (post_modified still 14:45 GMT).

Outside the task window: _elementor_page_assets (a:0:{}) is now gone from 230/231/232. It was still there in snapshot 10 (after these writes) and in 231's 15:17:41 pre-write backup, and only 3 posts site-wide still have it. So it was cleared site-wide by the later Elementor portal-chrome writes (15:23-15:29 GMT). It is a regenerated cache key and was not caused by this task.

findings.actual: max 894 px; 45 of 78 crops over 500; 3 crops differ by 1px in height (sub-pixel box height)
findings.note: Inspected diff-product-sugita-ii-head-frame-tq-ctas-768.png: only glyph pixels differ. Backgrounds, borders, radii, the arrow icon and the button boxes match exactly. The text sits a fraction of a pixel differently because of the inherited line-height (see measured.inherited_from_site). Crops were re-captured sub-pixel-aligned (body offset to integer page coordinates) to remove box-position noise. Kept as low: not a defect of this data write.

pixel.engine: pixelmatch + pngjs from plugin scripts/node_modules, threshold 0.1, fail_at 500 flat. visual_compare.py could not run because pixelmatch_compare.js spawns 'npx', which is ENOENT on Windows without a shell (spawnSync npx ENOENT). The shared script was not edited.
